An '''extendable sighting stock''' was a type of weapons [[Stock/Legends|stock]] which was equipped on [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]' [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. The stock was collapsible, folding up against the length of the weapon and nestling under the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. When extended and deployed, the extendable sighting stock gave the E-11 increased firing stability and long-range targeting.<ref name="EGWT" />
